title: The mode of a short list
source: S1 Ch2 theory S1-2.1 Quick check 1 (mode 9 appears three times)
stem: The values 6, {m|int}, 7, {m|int}, 4, {m|int}, 8 are recorded. What is the mode?

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The value \({m|int}\) occurs three times, which is more than any other value.

contexts.stem: A short list of scores is 6, {m|int}, 7, {m|int}, 4, {m|int}, 8. What is the mode?
The recorded times, in seconds, are 6, {m|int}, 7, {m|int}, 4, {m|int} and 8. What is the mode?

title: Frequency density of the modal class
source: S1 Ch2 theory S1-2.1 Quick check 2 (frequency densities 5, 8 and 6; modal class has density 8)
stem: A histogram of grouped lengths has frequency densities {p|int}, {q|int} and {r|int}. What is the frequency density of the modal class?

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The modal class is the class with the greatest frequency density.
steps.note: Use the definition of the modal class.

contexts.stem: Grouped masses are shown in a histogram whose three classes have frequency densities {p|int}, {q|int} and {r|int}. What is the frequency density of the modal class?
The frequency densities of three height classes are {p|int}, {q|int} and {r|int}. What is the frequency density of the modal class?

title: No modal class, frequencies in the same ratio as the widths
source: S1 Ch2 theory S1-2.1 Quick check 3 (widths 3:2, first frequency 48, second 32)
stem: Two classes have widths in the ratio {a|int}:{b|int}. There is no modal class, and the frequency of the first class is {f|int}. What is the frequency of the second class?

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: No modal class means that the frequency densities are equal, so the frequencies are in the same ratio as the widths.

contexts.stem: The widths of two classes are in the ratio {a|int}:{b|int}, and the classes have equal frequency density. If the first frequency is {f|int}, what is the second frequency?
There is no modal class for two classes whose widths are in the ratio {a|int}:{b|int}. The first class has frequency {f|int}. What is the frequency of the second class?

title: 9709/62/M/J/18 Q1(i): the mode of ten estimates

source.note: Stem verbatim from the QP PDF, part (i) only. Part (ii) (the median and the interquartile range) is omitted because those skills belong to later subsections. Official MS: 38 (B1). Independently, 38 occurs three times. A single official numeric part, so it is auto-marked with accept_as integer. No mixed marking.

stem:
Each of a group of 10 boys estimates the length of a piece of string. The estimates, in centimetres, are as follows.

37, 40, 45, 38, 36, 38, 42, 38, 40, 39

(i) Find the mode.

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: The estimate \(38\) occurs three times, which is more than any other value, so the mode is \(38\).
